notes.title: Important Update!
notes.content:
Hello,

We've heard from you about the save game issues. The problem occurred with some players, so it was harder to correctly assess what was wrong.

The game has been fixed and should work correctly for all players.

So minor bugs have been fixed as well.

I apologize for the problems personally.

The project still can evolve so will be great to hear feedback from all users.

Best Regards,
3DM Greg

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43107563/bcbc8fb68f996c9142bfcea6cf841a06756502a0.png[/img]

notes.title: REMASTER RELEASE OF OUR BESTSELLER
notes.content:
[h1]HELLO EVERYONE ![/h1]

Finally, our first full game (not as live wallpaper) is now ready in store with starting discount.

Desktop Farm Remastered is an answer to your needs. Some users asked me for a Farm as a normal game without playing on wallpaper. 

[b]This time we don't have limitations so the game graphics are much better. ;D[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43107563/244bd4134c139f0a9da2483ee411f5b03e7fff56.jpg[/img]

also, now we have music with many cool songs. 

[h1]Just RELAX and ENJOY IT.[/h1]

[b]I hope you will like it. :D[/b]

By the way. the house you build is a Minecraft copy of my grandparent's house where I grew up. :D

With any questions please visit Steam Community tab: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2159520/discussions/

or text me.

3DM
